<b>Building Up Songclave</b> is a [[Donate Wishes|Donate Wish]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>, found on the Wishwall of [[Songclave]]. 

== Wish ==
To complete the Wish, donate {{R|300}} to the Songclave Wishwall. <i>Building Up Songclave</i> is a prerequisite Wish required to unlock the <i>[[Strengthening Songclave]]</i> Wish.
